proposed_text.title: View Part History ON: the Part History icon is available on the inventory page (audit/story history now follow WO/WOL permissions)
proposed_text.custom_preconds:
1. A user has a role with the 'View Part History' setting ON (under the Parts group) and Parts Department + Catalog and Inventory View ON.
  2. An inventory part with some history exists.
proposed_text.custom_steps:
1. Open Parts > Inventory and find a part.
  2. Look for the Part History icon (clock icon, tooltip 'Part History') next to the part and open it.
proposed_text.custom_expected:
With View Part History ON, the Part History icon is shown on the inventory page and opens the part's history.

IMPORTANT — the toggle was repurposed by the 7/7 spec: 'View History Logs' was relabelled 'View Part History' and now controls ONLY inventory Part History. Work order and line AUDIT LOGS now follow Work Orders: Create & Edit; a line's STORY HISTORY follows Work Order Lines: View. So WO/line history is NO LONGER governed by this toggle. (Coverage note: the WO/line audit-log-under-WO-C&E and story-history-under-WOL-View behaviours should be covered by cases in the Work Orders / WO Lines sections, not here.)

NOTE (confirm live): SV-8202 is OPEN — the build may still show the legacy 'View History Logs' toggle with the old behaviour until that fix ships.

reason: 7/7 spec repurposed the setting: 'View History Logs'->'View Part History' controls only inventory Part History; WO/line audit log moved to WO Create & Edit and line story history to WOL View. The case still tests the OLD toggle-controls-WO/line-history model.
citation: Spec change log 7/7; §1h; SV-7989 (audit=WO C&E, story=WOL View); SV-8202 (open). LABEL-BATCH.md.

title: Office User: role permissions match the expected set
current_excerpt: Work orders View only; Work order lines off; ... Part sales View only; Catalog and Inventory View only; Vendor and order management View only; Invoicing & payments View only; ... View and Manage AP/AR Data on ...

proposed_text.custom_expected:
The Office User permissions match the expected set per the 7/14 spec update: Work Orders = NONE (no Work Orders access — the Work Orders nav is hidden for Office); Part Sales = NONE; Invoicing & Payments = View/Create & Edit/Delete (BUT a hard-coded rule disables the Create Invoice button for Office on both Work Orders and Part Sales — Office can make payments/deposits/credits but cannot create invoices); Customers full (including Delete); Catalog and Inventory View only; Vendor and Order Management View only; Timesheets View/Create & Edit; Schedule View only; Reports on; Billing Portal on; See Financial Data on; Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable on; Settings on with App Settings, Integrations, Finance, Data Import and View/Manage Wages; View mode Full View. The Office User role is non-editable (lock icon, eye only).

OPEN QUESTIONS to flag (do not assert a verdict): (1) the spec matrix lists Office Work Order Lines = View while Office Work Orders = none — a spec-internal contradiction (WOL View is supposed to inherit from WO View); confirm with PO. (2) HOW Office makes payments/deposits without being able to create invoices is still open with the PO (SV-7993 comment 73184 unanswered; SV-8345 closed deferring there) — verify the payment path live but treat the exact gating as PO-pending.

reason: The 7/14 spec update REDEFINED Office: Work Orders V->none, Part Sales V->none, Invoicing V->V/E/D (with the hard-coded no-Create-Invoice rule). The case still encodes the pre-7/14 Office (WO View, Part Sales View, Invoicing View). This is the single biggest behavioural drift in the recheck. Two spec-internal open items flagged, not silently resolved.
